source_note: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的
english_source_note: Nonexistence of a Limit for Sine on the Integers
callout_id: 证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的#8
statement_en:
The following sequences do not have limits: 
$$x_n:=\sin(\sqrt{n}),z_n:=\sin(\log(n)).$$
prerequisites: properties of logarithm and square root
callout_body:
下列序列的极限都不存在: 
$$x_n:=\sin(\sqrt{n}),z_n:=\sin(\log(n))$$
